difficulty.rationale: Single governing relationship (Coulomb's law, F proportional to q1q2/r^2) applied with two simultaneous proportional changes: doubling one charge gives x2, doubling distance gives x1/4, net 0.5. No arithmetic burden, minimal reading, no representation change. Distractors map to common errors (ignoring charge change, canceling, inverting the inverse-square). Fits skill 5.C at a foundational level.
